summary: Tested Indisponibilidades feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 13/14 passed (1 skipped: secondary user creation requires field name not exposed in /api/auth/register). All validations, overlap detection, /me, admin list with filters, /check (with/without horario), historico desc, update reset notif flags, delete owner permissions, and POST /api/time-entries/start early_leave_warning behaviour all PASS. Routes smoke import test (16 routers) passes including indisponibilidades.py. Frontend: /calendar loads OK, indisponibilidade-btn → modal → ind-add-btn → form (tipo/data/hora-inicio/hora-fim/regressa/aviso/observacoes) → ind-submit creates and shows toast 'Indisponibilidade registada'. Calendar day badge ('teste 09:00') visible on day-15 May (verified visually in screenshot). Day-detail modal shows 'INDISPONIBILIDADES (1)' section. APScheduler jobs scheduled_indisponibilidades_matinal (cron 7:00) e scheduled_indisponibilidades_pre_evento (cron 6-22, */5) confirmed registered + executing successfully in supervisor logs. Calendar.jsx contains conflict-dialog and conflict-proceed data-testids wired to /api/indisponibilidades/check; backend /check verified to return correct conflicts.

issues: A11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on multiple Dialogs (modal + form + day-detail). Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby.

action_items: Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to IndisponibilidadesModal, ind-form Dialog and Calendar day-detail Dialog to silence Radix a11y warnings.
Optional: expose secondary-user creation in test environment (or provide a non-admin token in test_credentials.md) so the 403-on-other-user PUT test is no longer skipped.

Optional: add data-testid to técnico select inside Nova FS modal to enable e2e automation of conflict-dialog flow (currently the multi-tech selector lacks per-option testids — backend conflict logic is verified and Calendar.jsx wiring is correct, but the UI flow ending in conflict-dialog cannot be reliably driven by Playwright without per-option testids).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/indisponibilidades.py — _doc_clean returns dict with 'data' converted via isoformat for the create endpoint, but list endpoints (/me, admin /, /check, /historico) return docs straight from Mongo where 'data' is already a string. Behaviour is consistent (string everywhere) but rely on the insert path keeping data as str — make sure no caller writes a date object directly.

routes/indisponibilidades.py — IndisponibilidadeUpdate is applied with model_dump(exclude_unset=True); however 'tipo' is validated only against VALID_TIPOS but the route never re-asserts the new tipo into update payload — currently fine because update dict is taken directly. Add explicit 'tipo' to update if you ever switch to model_validate.
routes/indisponibilidades.py — /check endpoint has no upper bound on user_ids list size; consider clamping (e.g. <= 200) to avoid pathological queries from admin UI.
Frontend Calendar.jsx (1250 lines) — well over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting Indisponibilidades section, Nova FS dialog and day-detail into sub-components.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral indisponibilidades created during tests; all cleaned up via fixture teardown and explicit DELETE pass. Verified GET /me has 0 TEST_ entries at end. Pre-existing 'Miguel Moreira · Saída Antecipada · 29/04/2026 14:00-17:30' was already in the DB — left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_indisponibilidades.py covers all 9 endpoints + early_leave_warning. Conflict-dialog UI flow couldn't be fully driven via Playwright because Nova FS técnico selector lacks per-option testids; backend /api/indisponibilidades/check is fully tested instead and Calendar.jsx code wiring (data-testid='conflict-dialog' + 'conflict-proceed') is confirmed by grep. APScheduler logs confirm both jobs are running on schedule.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only minor a11y warnings (DialogContent missing aria-describedby) and one skipped test due to test environment limitation (no easy way to create a non-admin user via public API).
